newsitem.title: UK: LME copper comes off lows, challenges resistance.
newsitem.headline: LME copper comes off lows, challenges resistance.

text.p: Copper prices continued their recovery on the London Metal Exchange during Friday's evening session to move ahead of Thursday's kerb close by 1900 GMT.

The $1,950 resistance which had posed problems earlier was taken out during the keb allowing the red metal to reach $1,971/$1,973 three months and challenging the more serious hurdle at $1,970 during the evening.
Borrowing tightened spreads and encouraged short covering, traders said.
The day's low of $1,919 was hit early and briefly threatened a move on the key $1,900 level.
"Overall the market continues to range trade roughly between $1,900 and $2,000...its been hit by profit-taking on any upside probes," one LME floor trader commented.
The other metals were lagely unmoved by copper's acceleration with aluminium barely above the kerb close at $1,426/$1,428 and the rest narrowly mixed.
